verdict.rationale: Phoenix is free to self-host with your data kept entirely in your own infrastructure (docs-27), and it is built on open standards (OpenTelemetry/OpenInference). Spans and traces can be queried programmatically via the SDK and through the MCP endpoint, which suggests data can be extracted. However, no evidence shows a documented bulk-export feature or the specific open formats it would produce. missing for 10: explicit export functionality for traces/datasets/experiments/prompts/annotations, documented open export formats (e.g., CSV/Parquet/JSON/OTLP out), a complete migration/off-boarding path, and independent corroboration.
